title: Sheaf completion inverts the adic base-change unit on arbitrary modules
statement: Let X be affine Noetherian and J ideal sheaf data. Put A=Γ(X,⊤), I=J(⊤), S=AdicCompletion I A. Let L be tilde followed by pullback along X≅Spec A and C be L followed by formal completion along J. For every A-module T, C sends the linear tensor unit T→S⊗T, x↦1⊗x, to an isomorphism of inverse systems. No finite generation of T is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0889(1), affine construction, using Algebra Tag 05GG and Schemes Tags 01I7, 01IC

proof.text: For each exponent n construct the completion evaluation quotient equivalence using its surjectivity and kernel I^n times the completion (05GG). Tensor with T and use Mathlib quotientTensorEquiv and quotTensorEquivQuotSMul. The range of tensoring the inclusion I^n S into S equals I^n times S tensor T by scalar and tensor induction. The resulting equivalence sends the class of x to the class of 1 tensor x, including at zero exponent. These are the proved private tensor_ideal_range and adic_tensor_unit_quotient helpers.

Apply the projection-compatible affine formal quotient comparison to T and S tensor T at every positive level. The algebraic quotient map is the equivalence of the previous step, by quotient induction and its formula on x. Cancel the source sheaf cokernel projection to identify the sheaf quotient map conjugated by the two comparisons with L of that algebraic isomorphism. Hence the component is invertible. The componentwise isomorphism criterion proves the natural transformation invertible. The original unit route is unchanged.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_completion_baseChange_unit
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsAffine X] (J : X.IdealSheafData) :
    let A := Γ(X, ⊤)
    let I := J.ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top X⟩
    let S := AdicCompletion I A
    let L := tilde.functor A ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback X.isoSpec.hom
    let C := L ⋙ formalCompletionFunctor J
    ∀ T : ModuleCat.{u} A,
      IsIso (C.map (ModuleCat.ofHom (TensorProduct.mk A S T (1 : S))))
